scenes.voice: Jio ka IPO list ho gaya aur isne stock market mein aag laga di! 1119 ka share seedha 1359 par khula.

scenes.voice: Retailers ne isko dhai guna bhara, par Institutions yani smart money ne isko massive 70 times subscribe kiya!
